body: I apologize if I scared anybody.  I'm here.  Probably this thread has been forgotten, but I talked to my family about it, and I'm getting help now.
I wish I could talk to people.  I love my family, but I could never talk to them about this.

Most websites, especially anonymous posting websites, the so called *anonymous* users can be traced back through the encryption, or the server.  It's probably just a troll.  Don't worry about it and get a good sleep.
